newsitem.title: FRANCE: French barley bidding starts at 20,000 T.
newsitem.headline: French barley bidding starts at 20,000 T.

text.p: A bid for a European Union barley export refund of 14.92 Ecus per tonne, channelled through France on Thursday, was for 20,000 tonnes, traders said.
It was the lowest refund in bidding which covered a total of 200,000 tonnes of free-market barley exports in the first EU grain auction of the season.
Including this bid, a cumulative volume of 45,000 tonnes of barley was sought in submissions up to 18 Ecus per tonne.
The cumulative volume at 19 Ecus was 75,000 tonnes.
French grain authorities said traders sought a total of 200,000 tonnes of free-market barley for export refunds between 14.92 and 22.78 Ecus but did not publish a breakdown.
